podcast.name: Week in Review

turns.text: Hello, and welcome. It's Sunday, November 8th. I'm Natasha, and this is Week in Review from MMH Daily.
Hi everyone, I’m William. We have a busy day.
We begin with health care.
Ministry of Health discusses draft revised Food Safety Law with international representatives and foreign embassies.

The drafting committee for the revised Food Safety Law held a working session with the Delegation of the European Union and the embassies of 12 countries to discuss recommendations concerning the draft legislation on the afternoon of November 6.
There’s also this: From QR codes to digital communities.

QR codes are becoming digital addresses for residents in rural areas of the central province of Quang Tri, helping delivery workers locate homes, rice traders find collection points and emergency services reach patients. The initiative is also laying the groundwork for forming digital communities at the grassroots level.
On the economic front.
Vietnam sets key economic targets for 2027.

General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee and State President To Lam, on behalf of the Party Central Committee, signed Conclusion No. 106-KL/TW, dated October 15, 2026, of the fourth meeting of the 14th Party Central Committee on socio-economic development, state budget implementation in 2026 and plans for 2027.
There’s also this: Accelerating public investment disbursement.

By the end of October 2026, many localities had achieved high public investment disbursement rates, thereby boosting economic growth. However, a substantial volume of capital remained to be disbursed in the final two months of the year.
Vietnam, Finland move to strengthen political trust, expand cooperation.

Politburo Member and Head of the Party Central Committee’s Commission for Publicity Trinh Van suggested that Finland further promote its role as a bridge between Vietnam and the European Union, while Vietnam could serve as a bridge between Finland and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations.
And this one: US to send largest-ever agricultural trade mission to Vietnam.
6 billion USD. The US’s 2025 agricultural exports to Vietnam increased 38 percent from 2024.
NA President attends inauguration of projects at Tan Trao special national historical site.
7 million USD) from the central budget. Construction began in December 2025 and was completed in less than 11 months despite extremely challenging conditions.
There’s also this: Vietnam-Japan trade machine has room to run.
Economic, trade and investment cooperation remains the core pillar and the main engine of comprehensive, sustainable bilateral ties.
Now to politics.
Top leader calls for a modern, safe, efficient coal industry, upholding spirit of "discipline and unity".

Upholding the tradition of "Discipline and Unity", General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee and President To Lam called for building a modern workforce, improving workers’ skills, promoting technological innovation and ensuring better living conditions.
There’s also this: Vietnamese community in Japan urged to futher contribute to national development.

Welcoming the Vietnamese community's efforts and contributions, the General Secretary and President affirmed that the Party and State will continue improving institutions and policies to create favourable conditions for overseas Vietnamese to engage more deeply in the country's socio-economic development and play a proactive role as partners and co-creators in nation-building.
Top leader and spouse depart for official visit to Japan.

General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee and President To Lam, his spouse Ngo Phuong Ly and a high-ranking Vietnamese delegation left Hanoi on November 8 for a four-day official visit to Japan at the invitation of the Japanese State.
There’s also this: Top Vietnamese leader begins official visit to Japan.

General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee To Lam, his wife Ngo Phuong Ly, and a high-ranking Vietnamese delegation arrived in Tokyo on November 8, beginning an official visit to Japan at the invitation of Japanese State.
Top leader’s visit to deepen Vietnam-Japan strategic cooperation: expert.

The upcoming visit to Japan by General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee and President To Lam is expected to give fresh impetus to the Vietnam-Japan Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, reflecting the strategic priorities of both countries, according to a Japanese expert.
Closer to home, on the society pages.
Vietnamese culture shines at festival in Australia.

Vietnamese Consul General in Perth Pham Hai Anh called on the Vietnamese community there to preserve the language, family traditions and national values, actively promote Vietnamese culture internationally and encourage creativity to bring national culture closer to the world while harmonising tradition with modernity.
And this one: When OCOP products become tourism resources.

No longer confined to shop shelves, One Commune One Product products are increasingly being incorporated into journeys to explore nature, experience local culture, and discover rural life. This approach is helping Ho Chi Minh City make better use of its local resources, expand markets for agricultural products, and create fresh impetus for rural economic development.
Gia Lai opens International Gong Festival.

Nearly 300 artisans representing 39 delegations from 10 cities and provinces, including Gia Lai, Quang Tri, Hue City and Da Nang, joined thousands of residents and domestic and foreign tourists at the event.
Another one to watch: Gia Lai promotes values of Central Highlands gong cultural heritage.

The 2026 Gong Festival – Wild Sunflower Week – Chu Dang Ya Volcano event took place at Dai Doan Ket Square in Pleiku City, Gia Lai Province on November 7, highlighted by a gong festival night performance.
Young visitors flood traditional food stalls at Green Vietnam Festival 2026.
From crispy Vietnamese pancakes to herbal teas, traditional foods with a modern, eco-friendly twist drew young visitors to the Green Vietnam Festival 2026 in Ho Chi Minh City on Saturday.
In the Vietnamese-language press, 6 more health stories are in today’s paper, covering tenders, policy and hospitals.
And that’s our show. Every story is in today’s paper, with summaries in Vietnamese. I'm William. Have a great day.
And I'm Natasha. Goodbye for now.
